questions.question: A worker is handling wet concrete without gloves. What is the main concern?
questions.explanation: Wet concrete is alkaline and can burn skin. Gloves protect workers from direct contact.

questions.question: Which tool is used to level fresh concrete?
questions.explanation: Screeds bring fresh concrete to grade. They remove excess concrete and level the surface.

questions.question: Why should drawings be reviewed before starting?
questions.explanation: Drawings show dimensions and details. Reviewing them helps prevent mistakes.

questions.category: Task 4 — Uses communication and mentoring techniques
questions.question: A worker is unsure about the pour sequence. What should they do?
questions.explanation: Good communication prevents mistakes. Asking questions improves safety and quality.

questions.question: Before concrete placement, soft subgrade is found. What should happen?
questions.explanation: Soft subgrade can settle. Settlement can cause cracking and uneven slabs.
